tools.name: get_agency_info
tools.description: Licensed identity of Via Rapida Services / Insurance City (Insurance City Agency, LLC, CA license #6003045): states, languages, phone, fee policy, verification link.

tools.name: get_offices
tools.description: The three California offices (Stockton, San Jose, San Rafael) with address, phone and hours.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Insurance products and services offered in California, with English/Spanish names and the page for each. Optional filter by line: personal, commercial or service.

tools.name: get_quote_link
tools.description: Where a person can start a quote for a product: the online quote portal (auto/SR-22), the product page with a callback form, phone and WhatsApp.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Via Rapida's California insurance guides and pages (costs, DMV, SR-22, FAIR Plan, workers' comp, city pages). Returns titles, URLs and summaries.

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Send the person's contact request to a licensed Via Rapida agent, who will call, text or email back (usually same business day). Only call this after the person explicitly asks to be contacted and confirms the details. Never include SSN, driver's license, bank or card numbers.

tools.name: get_quote_questions
tools.description: Get the questions a licensed agent needs to quote a product. Ask them to the person conversationally (a few at a time is fine), then call submit_quote_request with their answers. Tell the person you are an AI assistant and that a licensed agent reviews and prices the quote. Never ask for SSN, driver

tools.name: submit_quote_request
tools.description: Send the person's answers and contact details to a licensed agent, who prices the quote with our carriers and contacts them (usually same business day). Only call after the person reviewed their answers and agreed to be contacted. No prices are given in chat and nothing is bound.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guides, get_quote_questions · Private data: request_callback, submit_quote_request · Public sink: request_callback, submit_quote_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guides, get_quote_questions · Private data: request_callback, submit_quote_request · Public sink: request_callback, submit_quote_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
